# Skynot Labs

A human-directed software lab.

- **People direct.** A Manager agent proposes the work; you decide when it starts.
- **Code validates.** Rules, permissions and state live in the service, and every decision leaves an event in the log.
- **Delivery is reviewed.** One worktree per order, the project's own checks and a review before you merge.

## What we are building

- [**Skynot**](https://github.com/skynot-labs/skynot) — A dev shop of AI agents. In development, MIT.
- [**skynot-shop**](https://github.com/apps/skynot-shop) — The GitHub App a Skynot service acts as when it opens issues, branches and pull requests.
